swarm-rebuild.js is an unmodified copy of the upstream file, retained here
for an explicitly requested comparison on this blog. No license grant is
asserted by this notice. Upstream credits Joel Califa's original Swarm.
The blog's small loader is separate from this file.

The browser-extension background script and privileged tab-screenshot API
are not included. This comparison runs the upstream page animation engine
on the blog's DOM, images, and SVGs without installing an extension.
